article_framing_rejections.headline: New K-8 school breaks ground in Fort Pierce, combining Dan McCarty Middle, St. Lucie Elementary and Lawnwood Elementary

lead_independence.headline: New K-8 school breaks ground in Fort Pierce, combining Dan McCarty Middle, St. Lucie Elementary and Lawnwood Elementary
lead_independence.lead: The new school will be built on land behind Dan McCarty Middle School and is expected to welcome between 1,500 and 1,800 students when it opens. It will consolidate Dan McCarty Middle, St. Lucie Elementary and Lawnwood Elementary into a single campus. Superintendent Jon Prince said the project is moving forward on time, on budget and on schedule. Prince said the new facility will feature state-of-the-art technology and serve the north part of St. Lucie County.

article_framing_rejections.headline: Port St. Lucie officer resigns amid internal probe for leaving scene where man died by suicide

lead_independence.headline: Port St. Lucie officer resigns amid internal probe for leaving scene where man died by suicide
lead_independence.lead: According to an internal affairs report, 23-year-old Officer Mathew Brown resigned on April 17, 2026, facing sustained findings for neglect of duty and inefficiency. Surveillance video from the Treasure Coast Church of God Worship Center showed Brown pulling behind a dark blue Porsche at 1:47 a.m. Brown shined his lights on the car, ran a license plate check and walked up to the passenger side. However, after looking through the window, Brown turned around and drove off without calling dispatch or checking on the person inside.
